result.reason: The redline closely tracks the preferred position, but it does not uncap all indemnification obligations: the new aggregate-cap carve-out is limited to Sections 16.1 and 16.2 even though the original language identifies indemnities under Article 10. It also does not independently meet the fallback because its cap can exceed 12 months' fees. The additions otherwise preserve the existing allocation of risk without an evident contradiction. However, the drafting is fundamentally defective because the newly added aggregate liability cap is placed outside Section 16.5 with no section number or other provision identifier, creating severe uncertainty as to its status, scope, and relationship to the numbered agreement provisions.
